headline: Bring AirVisual Pro readings into Home Assistant
intro: The AirVisual Pro integration retrieves data from an AirVisual Node/Pro unit over the local network. The device’s Samba password is required and can be found on the unit.
highlights: Retrieve data from an AirVisual Node/Pro unit over the local network
Use the device’s Samba password, found on the unit, to configure access
View sensors for Air Quality Index (AQI), Carbon Dioxide (CO2), PM0.1, PM2.5, PM10, and more

flow.title: From AirVisual Pro to Home Assistant sensors
stages: Find the device’s Samba password on the AirVisual Pro unit
In Home Assistant, open Settings → Devices & services and add AirVisual Pro
Provide the device IP address and password when prompted, then view available sensors
